title: WF v8 critique (critique/rN-<seat>.json)
description: One critic seat's review of one round (research/v7/WF-V8-PLAN.md "Shared data"; WF-REVIEW-opus.md C5). Rewrite the whole file after every item with done:false; set done:true when the list is complete. At most 10 items. Keys come from the packet's knob and part tables. A MAJOR needs `at` (machine-checkable evidence): merge.mjs merges a MAJOR without a verified `at` as MINOR. Rects are in the named image's OWN px (the turnaround view file or the concept image), never page px.

round.description: the round whose model is reviewed

done.description: false while writing; true when the list is complete (merge.mjs refuses false)

sev.description: MAJOR: a measured discrepancy >= 0.05 m or >= 3 % of the view's dimension, or a missing / extra / wrong-count feature; else MINOR

key.description: knob:<KNOBS name> | def:<DEFAULTS path, dots> | part:<part family>.<pos.x|pos.y|pos.z|size.x|size.y|size.z|rot|colour|shape|count|add|remove> | drift:<view> (a drift-rect proposal: `at.rect` is the rect)

now.description: the model's current value (null when the key has none)

want.description: the value the references ask for (same unit as now)

views.description: the images the item shows in (concept, side, front, rear, top)

basis.description: the image the want is measured on (concept | side | front | rear | top)

at.description: where the claim can be checked: merge.mjs rebuilds the model's raster of `image` and tests `claim` inside `rect`

rect.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] in that image's own px (half-open)

claim.description: ref-only / model-only: >= 10 % of the rect's px are reference-only / model-only silhouette; colour: the reference's colour family in the rect differs from the model's, the reference shows want's family and the model now's (hex now / want); edge: >= 1 px differs

evidence.description: the commands that measured it (node scripts/v7/measure.mjs ...)

reopens.description: the decided key this item reopens (needs a verified `at` on the decided item's basis image), else null
